items.name: Corvée System
items.desc: This society considers it the absolute right of the state to decide where its citizens live and work.
items.effects: - Waives all £unity£ §YUnity§! costs for £pop£ §YPop Resettlement§!.

items.name: Imperial Cult
items.desc: This society has a dominant state religion where the ruler is worshiped as a living deity.
items.effects: - Ruler's §YHome Planet§! has additional [GetPriestIcon] [GetPriest] Jobs

items.name: Beacon of Liberty
items.desc: This society is a shining beacon of light in a sea of darkness. Liberty and individual freedoms are held in the highest regard here.

items.name: Exalted Priesthood
items.desc: To guard against heresy, this society is ruled by a religious council consisting of the wisest and most pious members of the clergy.
items.effects: - £job_politician£ §YPolitician§! Jobs are converted to £job_high_priest£ §YHigh Priests§!\nThe £building£ §YCitadel of Faith§! grants additional £job_high_priest£ §YHigh Priests§! jobs.

items.name: Philosopher King
items.desc: It is not enough to simply rule. The Ship of State must be guided by a king that wields enough wisdom and knowledge to steer it true.

items.name: Meritocracy
items.desc: An individual's social station or personal connections should have no bearing on their profession. The sole basis for advancement in this society is demonstrated ability and talent.

items.name: Citizen Service
items.desc: Are you doing your part? Full citizenship and the political responsibility that comes with it is limited to those who have served a tour of duty in the military. Service guarantees citizenship.
items.effects: Grants access to the £building£ §YRecruitment Office§! Holding

items.name: Technocracy
items.desc: To maximize efficiency, this society is governed according to the principles of science and rationality. The personal whims of an ignorant and dangerously unqualified political elite must not be allowed to interfere.
items.effects:
- £job_politician£ §YPolitician§! Jobs are converted to £job_head_researcher£ §YScience Directors§!
- The £building£ §YResearch Institute§! grants additional £job_head_researcher£ §YScience Directors§! Jobs
- §Y£scientist£ Scientists§! start with random §YExpertise§! trait
- §YExpertise§! traits have additional effects
- Start with an additional §Y£scientist£ Scientist§! as the Governor of your Homeworld

items.name: Feudal Society
items.desc: This society is organized in a feudal manner, with a monarch whose rule relies on powerful vassals that govern their territories with considerable autonomy.
items.effects:
- Ignore §YDiplomatic Requirements§! when proposing §YSubjugation§!
- Your §YSubjects§! cannot have the following Agreement Terms:
    £trigger_no£ §YExpansion Prohibited§!
    £trigger_no£ §YDo not join subject wars§!
    £trigger_no£ §YLimited Diplomacy§!

items.name: Police State
items.desc: To quash any traces of dissent, the population in this repressive society is carefully monitored and controlled by a large internal police force.

items.name: Idealistic Foundation
items.desc: This society was founded on strong idealistic values. Whether the current government remains true to them or not, the people have not forgotten.

items.name: Environmentalist
items.desc: This society seeks to co-exist in harmony with nature. Great care is taken to preserve the environment and limit consumerism where possible.
items.effects: - Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_ranger_lodge']\n    - Additional Starting Buildings: £building£ §YRanger Lodge§!\n    - Available Holdings: £building£ ['building:holding_park_ranger_lodge']

items.name: Slaver Guilds
items.desc: Much of the true political power in this society rests with a number of powerful and ruthless slaver guilds. They know how to get the most out of a slave.

items.name: Inward Perfection
items.desc: This calm and pacifist society has little use for strangers who do not understand its way of life. More than anything, these people would prefer to be left alone.
items.effects:
Cannot have §YRivals§!
Cannot form §YDefensive Pacts§!
Cannot form §YMigration Treaties§!
Cannot form §YResearch Agreements§!
Cannot form §YCommercial Pacts§!
Cannot §YGuarantee Independence§!
Cannot join §YFederations§!
Cannot §YInfiltrate§! pre-FTLs
Cannot have forced §YSubjects§!
Cannot use §YUnrestricted Wars§! policy

items.name: Warrior Culture
items.desc: This society has developed into a hardy warrior culture. Martial prowess is valued above all else, and true glory can only be found on the field of battle.
items.effects: - Replaces £job_entertainer£ §YEntertainer§! Jobs with £job_duelist£ §YDuelist§! Jobs.\n- £job_duelist£ §YDuelists§! turn £alloys£ §YAlloys§! into £unity£ §YUnity§!, £mod_planet_amenities_add£ §YAmenities§!, and £mod_country_naval_cap_add£ §YNaval Capacity§!.\n- Replaces £job_xeno_zoo_animal£ §YConserved Fauna§! Jobs with £job_xeno_zoo_beast£ §YGladiatorial Beast§! Jobs.

items.name: Distinguished Admiralty
items.desc: The Fleet and the Admiralty have unusually prominent roles in this society, wielding a great deal of influence in political circles. They have the pick of the litter when it comes to new military recruits.

items.name: Free Haven
items.desc: This society has a well-earned reputation as a free haven. The tired, the poor, the huddled masses yearning to breathe free - all are welcome here, regardless of their species or origin.

items.name: Cutthroat Politics
items.desc: The political system in this society is renowned for its intrigue. Power struggles, shady backroom deals and cloak and dagger scheming are par for the course. Those who survive long enough to learn the game, however, tend to learn it well.

items.name: Corporate Dominion
items.desc: This society is dominated by a megacorporation that has completely supplanted the role of the state.
items.effects: Starts with the §YOffworld Trade Companies§! technology already unlocked\n§YUnlocks Ship Type:§! Private Colony Ship

items.name: Agrarian Idyll
items.desc: A simple and peaceful life can often be the most rewarding. This agrarian society has, to a large extent, managed to avoid large-scale urbanization.
items.effects:
§YAgriculture Districts§! provide §G400§! more £housing£ §YHousing§!.
§YGenerator Districts§! and §YMining Districts§! provide §G300§! more £housing£ §YHousing§!.
§YCity Districts§! provide §R200§! less £housing£ §YHousing§!.
£job_farmer£ §YFarmers§! also produce §G200§! £amenities£ §YAmenities§!.

items.name: Shadow Council
items.desc: Unbeknownst to its own citizens, this society is actually manipulated from behind the scenes by a secretive shadow council. Appearances must be kept, but the tyranny of the majority should also be guarded against. After all, what if the fools vote for the wrong candidate?

items.name: Mining Guilds
items.desc: Several large mining guilds have reached a dominant position in this society. The government relies heavily on their support.

items.name: Parliamentary System
items.desc: The parliamentary system in this society encourages a free and lively debate. Currying favor with one of the dominant political factions can prove to be quite advantageous.
items.effects: - Factions will form in your empire shortly after the game starts, but Faction Output is reduced for the first ten years.

items.name: Efficient Bureaucracy
items.desc: This society is renowned for its efficiency. Not only do the mag-trains run on time, but the colossal bureaucratic apparatus required to run an interstellar nation has been greatly streamlined.
items.effects: £job_bureaucrat£ §YBureaucrats§! and §Y[GetPriestIcon] [GetPriestPlural]§! provide §Y£mod_country_edict_fund_add£ Edict Fund§! scaling with their £unity£ §YUnity§! production.

items.name: Nationalistic Zeal
items.desc: A strong sense of nationalistic pride permeates all layers of this society.

items.name: Functional Architecture
items.desc: This society is renowned for its simple yet functional architecture. There are those who would refer to this building style as boring or even depressing, but in most cases, neo-concrete does the job just as well as any other building material.
items.effects: - Waives §YTechnology§! requirements for £zone£ Basic ['concept_district_specializations']

items.name: Aristocratic Elite
items.desc: This society has an entrenched nobility that occupies the upper echelons of society.
items.effects:
- £job_politician£ §YPolitician§! Jobs are converted into £job_noble£ §YNoble§! Jobs
- Can construct £building£ §YNoble Estates§! buildings that add additional £job_noble£ §YNoble§! Jobs
- Grants access to the £building£ §YNoble Chateaus§! Holding
- §YLeaders§! have a §Y20%§! chance to start with an additional positive and negative trait.

items.name: Shared Burdens
items.desc: This society believes in an equitable distribution of resources, making little to no distinction between the needs of ruler and ruled. All work together for the benefit of the whole.
items.effects: Allows §YShared Burdens§! Living Standard, under which all £pop£ §HPops§! have moderate £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! Upkeep regardless of §YStrata§!\nDisables the use of most other §YLiving Standards§!\nGrants access to the £building£ §YCommunal Housing Outreach§! Holding

items.name: Fanatic Purifiers
items.desc: This society appears hellbent on scouring the galaxy of all other sapient life. Come what may, they will suffer no xenos to live.
items.effects:
Cannot engage in §YDiplomacy§! with other species!
Cannot access the §YGalactic Market§!
Has the §Y'Purification'§! casus belli on other species
§YXeno Pops§! will always be purged
Gains £unity£ §YUnity§! from purging £pop£ §HXeno Pops§!
May use §YArmageddon§! bombardment stance

items.name: Barbaric Despoilers
items.desc: This society holds few things sacred. To fight is to live, and the strongest may seize whatever they covet.
items.effects:
Cannot form §YMigration Treaties§!
Cannot form (but can join) §YFederations§! other than §YMartial Alliances§! or §YHegemonies§!
Has the '§YDespoliation§!' casus belli on all other empires
Unlocks the §YRaiding§! bombardment stance, which in turn allows us to abduct pops from besieged planets and resettle them to our own worlds.
Decreased §YOpinion§! for most other empires

items.name: Byzantine Bureaucracy
items.desc: This society is largely governed by a complex and, to the outsider, almost labyrinthine system of bureaucracy. An army of officials and functionaries work tirelessly to keep the government running smoothly and ensure no citizens are allocated resources they cannot demonstrate a properly filed and triple-stamped need for.

items.name: Merchant Guilds
items.desc: A number of powerful and very influential merchant guilds have risen to prominent positions in this society. They hold significant sway with the government.
items.effects: - £job_politician£ §YPolitician§! Jobs are converted to £job_merchant£ §YMerchant§! Jobs\n- The £building£ §YGalactic Stock Exchange§! grants additional £job_merchant£ §YMerchants§! Jobs.

items.name: Reanimators
items.desc: Within this society, death is no bar to the call to arms. Masters of the art of necromancy reanimate corpses to raise dread hosts and guardians, striking fear into the hearts of lesser mortals.
items.effects:
- §Y£job_soldier£ Soldiers§! are replaced with §Y£job_necromancer£ Necromancers§!
- Available Buildings: ['building:building_dread_encampment']
- Available Holdings: ['building:holding_dread_outpost']
- Defeated §YOrganic Armies§! are sometimes resurrected as §YUndead Armies§!
- Defeated organic §YLeviathans§! can sometimes be resurrected
- Controlled cloned organic §YSpace Fauna§! can be reanimated

items.name: Diplomatic Corps
items.desc: This society has a long tradition of rhetoric and debate, and celebrate those who are able to get their way using only words.

items.name: Death Cult
items.desc: This society's religion is built around periodic, ritual sacrifice. Willing initiates devote themselves to a decade of study before meeting an end whose effects ripple throughout their culture.
items.effects:
- Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_sacrificial_temple_1'] 
    - Additional Starting Buildings: £building£ §YSacrificial Temple§!  
    - Available Holdings: £building£ ['building:holding_sacrificial_shrine'] 
    - Access to ['concept_sacrifice_edicts'] 
    - £job_priest£ Priests are converted into £job_death_priest£ Death Priests

items.name: Memorialists
items.desc: This empire pays tribute to memories and sapients of the past, deriving greater stability and insight from the continuous cycles of death, rebirth and legacy.
items.effects: - Can build £building£ §HSanctuary of Repose§!\n- §HSanctuaries of Repose§! improve §HGoverning Ethics Attraction§! on §HTomb Worlds§! and §HRelic Worlds§!\n- £job_death_chronicler£ Death Chroniclers turn £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! into £unity£ §YUnity§! and £stability£ §YStability§!, and inherit the §HEthics-based§! modifiers of [civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural]

items.name: Catalytic Processing
items.desc: By focusing their industrial efforts on catalytic chemistry, this civilization has unlocked the key to using organic materials in the construction of spacebound structures.
items.effects: - §Y[foundry.GetIcon] [foundry.GetNamePlural]§! are replaced with §Y£job_catalytic_technician£ Catalytic Technicians§!\n    - [foundry.GetIcon] [artisan.GetIcon] §YIndustrial Jobs§! have their £minerals£ §YMinerals§! Upkeep replaced with £food£ §YFood§! Upkeep.

items.name: Masterful Crafters
items.desc: A penchant for meticulous crafting lies at the heart of this society. Deft appendages and keen sensory organs aid them in creating truly wondrous treasures even in the most basic of trades.
items.effects: £job_artisan£ §YArtisans§! are replaced with £job_artificer£ §YArtificers§!\n£job_artificer£ §YArtificers§! turn £minerals£ §YMinerals§! into £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! and £trade£ §YTrade§!
items.possible: always = yes

items.name: Pleasure Seekers
items.desc: This society rejoices in its own perfection. Those who are elevated by their privileged social structure have surrendered to a culture which glorifies pleasure and entertainment, regardless of a cost typically borne by others.
items.effects:
- £pop_cat_civilian£ §YCivilians§! are replaced with £job_fe_hedonist£ ['concept_hedonists'] 
    - Allows the ['concept_decadent_lifestyle'] Living Standard 
    - Additional Starting Buildings: 
        - £building£ ['building:building_factory_1']
        - £building£ ['building:building_holo_theatres']

items.name: Idyllic Bloom
items.desc: This society has long dedicated itself to environmental care and improvement, striving to create a true paradise for its inhabitants.
items.effects: Can build £building£ §YGaia Seeders§! on your and your vassal's worlds ideal to your starting species.\nFacilities spread across the planet progressively bring it closer to becoming a §YGaia World§!, through 4 upgrade phases.\nAs you unlock improved £society£ §YTerraforming§! technologies, £building£ §YGaia Seeders§! can be constructed on additional planet types.

items.name: Anglers
items.desc: This society is well-adapted to an aquatic environment, using the bounty of the sea to fuel its economy.
items.effects:
- On §YOcean Worlds§!, §YAgriculture Districts§! are uncapped.
    - On §YWet§! worlds:
        - §YAgriculture Districts§! have the £zone£ §YAquaculture§! Specialization 
        - £job_farmer£ Farmers are converted into £job_angler£ Anglers 
        - £job_artisan£ Artisans are converted into £job_pearl_diver£ Pearl Divers

items.name: Marine Machines
items.desc: This mechanical society is engineered for seamless operation in diverse aquatic environments and excels in crafting unparalleled marine infrastructure to drive its economy.
items.effects:
- On §YOcean Worlds§!, §YAgriculture Districts§! are uncapped.
    - On §YWet§! worlds:
        - §YAgriculture Districts§! have the £zone£ §YAquaculture§! Specialization 
        - £job_farmer£ Farmers are converted into £job_angler£ Anglers 
        - £job_artisan£ Artisans are converted into £job_pearl_diver£ Pearl Divers

items.name: Pompous Purists
items.desc: A society so utterly convinced of their own superiority, that any attempt at diplomacy not initiated by themselves will be utterly ignored.
items.effects: Can only engage in §YDiplomacy§! with other empires if they are the proposer.

items.name: Mutagenic Spas
items.desc: This civilization engages in ritualistic mutagenic bathing, with professional attendants overseeing the use of highly dangerous substances. This 'invigorating' process may appall uninitiated onlookers.
items.effects: - Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_toxic_bath'] \n- Leaders with the §YSubstance Abuser§! trait gain §G+3§! Effective Leader Skill Level while governing a £colony£ Colony with £building£ §YMutagenic Spas§!.

items.name: Relentless Industrialists
items.desc: To live is to exploit. This civilization is built around the principle of living life to the fullest, in the sense of squeezing the maximum profit from every last ounce of matter and membrane available for exploitation.
items.effects: Can build £building£ §YCoordinated Fulfillment Center§!, significantly increasing £alloys£ §YAlloy§! and £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! output at the cost of reduced £mod_logistic_growth_mult£ §YPop Growth§! and gradually turning planets into §YTomb Worlds§!.

items.name: Scavengers
items.desc: In this society, nothing goes to waste, even in the grimmest times of war: no enemy technology will go undiscovered, as teams of scrappers accompanying the war fleets scrape wreckages of anything and everything worth salvaging.
items.effects: - Researching §HDebris§! grants both £physics£ £society£ £engineering£ §YResearch§! and a portion of other §YResource Costs§! of the destroyed fleet\n- §HShips§! can be salvaged from some §HDebris§!

items.name: Ascensionists
items.desc: The ultimate goal of this empire is to ascend to ever greater levels of fulfillment.
items.effects: - Colonies have §G+1§! §YAscension Tier§! on game start.

items.name: Vaults of Knowledge
items.desc: The knowledge, principles, and experiences of exceptional people are digitized and accumulated in the Vaults of Knowledge. Citizens can access this source of wisdom and experience to learn from the ghosts of the past.
items.effects: Can build unique £building£ §YVaults of Knowledge§!\n£building£§YVaults of Knowledge§! produce £unity£ §YUnity§! and increase §YLeader Experience Gain§! based on §YDestiny Traits§! acquired.

items.name: Crusader Spirit
items.desc: The lack of guidance creates weak minds - which easily succumb to corruption and plunge into decadence. This society has assumed the self-imposed mantle of bringing "enlightenment" to the masses through aggressive proselytizing.
items.effects: §Y£commander£ Commanders§! start with the §YCrusader§! Trait\nCan only use §YLiberation Wars§! policy

items.name: Eager Explorers
items.desc: §RWARNING: Challenging Civic§!\nYearning for the stars, this civilization sped through several stages of development, reaching the age of galactic exploration far earlier than most.
items.effects: Start with 2 §HExploration Vessels§! and an §HEngineering Vessel§! equipped with §HSubspace Drives§!, making them incapable of Hyperlane travel but granting limited Jump Drive abilities.\nGain an increased chance to discover §HFTL Travel§! Technologies

items.name: Hyperspace Specialty
items.desc: This society has always embraced speed. The manipulation of hyperspace is just another thoroughfare, and those with aptitude in the field have risen to the highest caste.
items.effects: £physics£ §YHyperlane Breach Points§! is Guaranteed Research Option.\nHas Low Intel on all systems within 3 Hyperlanes of your starting system.

items.name: Dimensional Worship
items.desc: This society believes that a divine existence lies beyond the folds in space and time. Systems where instabilities are highest hold a sacred meaning to them as sites of both pilgrimage and research.
items.effects: - Available Starbase Buildings: ['starbase_building:dimensional_shrine', Dimensional Shrine]

items.name: Heroic Past
items.desc: The legendary heroes of the past inspire each new generation to achieve the extraordinary. As role models, government officials embody these ideals.

items.name: Oppressive Autocracy
items.desc: Only the elite of the elite deserve the best of the best. Everyone else is expected to provide for the ruling class and their lackeys.
items.effects:
- £job_enforcer£ Enforcers are £pop_cat_ruler£ §YElites§! instead of £pop_cat_specialist£ §YSpecialists§!
- Only £pop_cat_ruler£ §YElites§! can produce £mod_planet_amenities_add£ §YAmenities§! and have £mod_planet_amenities_add£ §YAmenities§! Upkeep
- Forces §YDystopian Society§! Living Standard, under which §Ynon-Elite§! Pops have decreased £consumer_goods£ §YConsumer Goods§! Upkeep
- §YNon-Elite§! Pops generate additional £crime£ §YCrime§!
- Cannot build £building£ §Y['building_holo_theatres']§!

items.name: Selective Kinship
items.desc: In an uncertain universe, only kin can be trusted. This civilization is selective about the species it defines as equals.
items.effects:
Opinion of Empires with shared ['concept_species_class']: §G+100§!
Opinion of other Empires: §R-50§!
Refugee Attraction with our §YSpecies Class§!: §G+30%§!
Refugee Attraction with other §YSpecies Classes§!: §R-20%§! 
£pop£ §HPops§! of our §YSpecies Class§! have Full Citizenship
Other £pop£ §HPops§! are barred from Full Citizenship

items.name: Dark Consortium
items.desc: A deep understanding of the architecture of the universe allowed this society to exploit the mysterious properties of dark matter long before the discovery of the hyperdrive.
items.effects:
- Additional Starting Technologies:
        - ['technology:tech_mine_dark_matter', £physics£Dark Matter Drawing] 
    - Access to ['concept_dark_matter_edicts'] 
    - Has access to the §YDark Matter Breakthrough§! Council Agenda.

items.name: Natural Design
items.desc:
§RWARNING: Blocks all Ascension Paths§!
§RWARNING: Unable to modify organic species§!

This society is adamant that nature has already created perfection in its people's genetic code. They have long devoted their medical and governmental services to the health and preservation of natural, untouched genome sequences.
items.effects: Available Buildings: ['concept_transcendental_retreat']\n

items.name: Sovereign Guardianship
items.desc: This collection of warring tribes has developed a historical preference for entrenched territories and defensive posturing. Now united, they are prepared to bring this philosophy to the stars, aiming to keep their borders solid and tensions low.
items.effects: Unlocks §YFanatic Guardians§! as defense armies.\nAllows building a §YReloading Bay§! in starbases.\nEnables §YInner Focus§! §HEdict§!, converting £influence£ §YInfluence§! into £unity£ §YUnity§!.

items.name: Genesis Guides
items.desc: This society is devoted to the creation of emerging species. As the stewards of evolution's potential, they allocate portions of their worlds to safeguard the development of pre-sapient life forms.
items.effects:
- Available Colony Ships: §YGenesis Ark§!
- Planets Colonized with §YGenesis Arks§!:
    - Pre-Sapient Pops: §G+300§! 
    - Planetary Features: §YGenesis Preserve§! 
- Gains £unity£ §YUnity§! from uplifting Pre-Sapient Species

items.name: Lubrication Tanks
items.desc: This machine empire improved upon its basic drone-shell production through the vigorous application of highly aggressive lubrication agents, controlled by carefully programmed terminals. This 'optimized' process relies on typically wasted byproducts from the industries that are now repurposed for maximal efficiency.
items.effects: - Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_toxic_bath_machine'] \n- Leaders with the §YSubstance Abuser§! trait gain §G+3§! Effective Leader Skill Level while governing a £colony£ Colony with £building£ §YHyper Lubrication Basin§!.

items.name: Rapid Replicator
items.desc: This society has taken control of the means of self-assembly. Each machine begets another, forming an unbroken chain stretching our planet's limits.

items.name: Static Research Analysis
items.desc: This society excels in predictive analysis within research methodologies, ensuring the pursuit of only the most promising leads.

items.name: Warbots
items.desc: This society constantly refines its armies, economy, and education for diverse warfare strategies. Each machine contributes to collective strength, ensuring adaptability and success in conflict.

items.name: Astrometeorology
items.desc: With deep respect for the forces of nature, this species goes to great lengths to uncover the inner workings of environmental phenomena. As they set out across the stars, they take with them a particular interest in astrometeorology. Central to their ambitions are the most fantastic and potentially destructive of all astronomical events, the cosmic storms themselves.\n
items.effects: - Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_astrometeorology_observation_center']\n    - Additional Starting Buildings: £building£ §YAstrometeorology Observatory§! \n    - §YStellar Observatory§! Output: §G+50%§!

items.name: Storm Devotion
items.desc: Ever since ancient times, this society has been able to attract tempests through their rituals. Over the years, they combined technical innovations to enhance their efficiency. With the dawn of the space age, they now seek to take this knowledge to the stars.
items.effects: - Available Buildings: £building£ ['building:building_storm_summoning_theater']\n- Replaces £job_entertainer£ §HEntertainer§! Jobs with £job_storm_dancer£ §HStorm Dancer§! Jobs\n- Species Traits: ['trait:trait_storm_touched']

items.name: Planetscapers
items.desc: After eons of carefully cultivating a perfect balance on their homeworld, this society is ready to tend to even the most inhospitable environments among the stars. At their core, these people believe nature can be shaped, controlled, and perfected. Not to tame, but in service of perfect beauty.
items.effects:
- Additional Starting Technologies: £society£ §HTechnologies§! to remove £blocker£ ['concept_natural_blockers'] on the §HHomeworld§!
- £society£ §HTechnologies§! to remove £blocker£ §HNatural Blockers§! are granted as §HPermanent Research Options§! upon Colonization
- §HMastery of Nature§! ['concept_ascension_perk'] replaced with §HCultivated Worldscaping§! Planetary ['concept_decision']
- For each £blocker£ §HNatural Blocker§! on Colonized £planet£ ['concept_planets']:
    - Resources from Jobs: §R-10%§!
    - Pop Growth Speed: §R-10%§!
    - Pop Upkeep: §R+15%§!

items.name: Galactic Curators
items.desc: The meticulous collection and preservation of historical artifacts has always fascinated this civilization. But now, with the mysteries of the galaxy at their doorstep, there is everything left to learn.
items.effects:
- Guaranteed Research Options: ['technology:tech_galactic_archivism', £society_research£Galactic Archivism]
- Initial ['concept_specimen', Specimens]: One §0Common§! of each Collection Category 
- Gain £unity£ §YUnity§! each time you find a §YSpecimen§! or complete an §YArchaeological Site§! 
- Purchases from the §YCurator Enclave§!: §G$@galactic_curators_curator_enclave_purchase_cost|%0$§!
- Enables the §YDecentralized Research§! Edict, increasing §YResearch Station§! Output but decreasing £job_researcher£ §Y[GetResearcher]§! Job Output
- Replaces £job_entertainer£ §YEntertainer§! Jobs with £job_historical_curator£ §YMuseum Curator§! Jobs

items.name: Beastmasters
items.desc: Coming to full, technological maturity in a system that serves as a feeding ground for Space Amoebas, this society has acquired a deep knowledge of their life cycle. They now work to nurture, raise, and ultimately clone these creatures for mutual benefit.
items.effects:
- Additional Starting Technologies:
        - ['technology:tech_gravity_wells', £physics£Gravity Snares]
        - ['technology:tech_alien_cloning', £society£Artificial Breeding]
    - Available Starbase Buildings: ['concept_beastport', Beastports]
    - Home System: Start with a ['concept_beastport']
    - Starting §YMilitary Ships§! are replaced with §YSpace Amoebas§!
    - Starting £genetic_material£ ['concept_dna']:
        - §0Common§! Space Amoeba

items.name: Genetic Identification
items.desc: This society requires every citizen to be registered from birth in a genetic index used in every level of bureaucracy.

items.name: Crowdsourcing
items.desc: This society has realized that individual inspiration is the root of true innovation. Open-source patents, open-mindedness, spontaneous collaborations and innovation bounties pave the way to progress.
